0022600128.text: The Boston Celtics (2-1, 2-0 at home, on a two-game winning streak) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) in Boston's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Celtics second in the Atlantic, half a game back, and seventh in the East, while Brooklyn is fifth in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and 14th in the East. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, while Brooklyn will be without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder sprain, and Mikel Brown Jr., who is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and Boston won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 148-111 win over Brooklyn in Boston on February 27, 2026.
